snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 on Android supercharged by NVIDIA Tegra2
snippet.description:
Galaxy on Fire 2™ is finally coming to Android this year! Devices powered by NVIDIA's Tegra 2 3D will give you a stunning graphic experience of the epic sci-fi adventure awarded best Adventure Game on iPhone in 2010.  Powered by NVIDIA the game features a four times higher texture size and a six times higher poly count on its spaceships than on the iPad.
The supported Android devices and pricing of the game will be announced soon.
